item.title: Triumph for the right to open windows in Penrith
item.description: Persimmon Homes has won its appeal against Westmorland and Furness Council to remove a planning restriction that required non-opening windows in bedrooms due to fears over noise from the nearby railway. The post Triumph for the right to open windows in Penrith appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cheshire East shares vision for primary school by Crewe
item.description: Situated in the council’s Basford East strategic site, the school would have capacity for 210 students with the ability to double in size down the line. The post Cheshire East shares vision for primary school by Crewe appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Heaton Chapel Tesla garage to make way for housing
item.description: MSA Business Developments wants to build 10 townhouses and 28 apartments on the site of a showroom on the A6. The post Heaton Chapel Tesla garage to make way for housing appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Southway proposes Levenshulme Cricket Club pads
item.description: The housing association wants to build 50 affordable houses at the disused Elsa Road sports field. The post Southway proposes Levenshulme Cricket Club pads appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Rochdale seeks contractor for £11.4m SEN school
item.description: Procurement is underway for a design-and-build contract to deliver a secondary school for 64 students with social, emotional, and mental health needs off Mayfield Street. The post Rochdale seeks contractor for £11.4m SEN school appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Hunt joins Crossbay as UK VP
item.description: Ex-Canmoor director Rodney Hunt has joined the European last mile logistics platform to help lead its investment and asset management division. The post Hunt joins Crossbay as UK VP appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wirral considers reneging on Persimmon land deal
item.description: Council members will decide on Monday whether or not to revoke an agreement to sell a nearly four-acre site off Ditton Lane in Moreton after a campaign group made the case for the environmental benefits of keeping the plot development-free. The post Wirral considers reneging on Persimmon land deal appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: THING OF THE WEEK
item.description: Brass bands, film crews, and half marathons. The post THING OF THE WEEK appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Crompton Place, the heart of Bolton’s regeneration journey
item.description: Over recent years, the focus of placemaking has shifted from short-term interventions towards a more co-ordinated approach, one that recognises the town centre as a place to live, work and spend time, writes Jon Dyson of Bolton Council. The post Crompton Place, the heart of Bolton’s regeneration journey appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Judge sides with Trafford on Carrington industrial dispute
item.description: The council was justified in rejecting the application due to a lack of financial contribution to the Carrington Relief Road, according to a High Court justice. The post Judge sides with Trafford on Carrington industrial dispute appeared first on Place North West.
